Name: Yearly Night Market Pearl
Author: TechnicalityCreations
Description:
Apart from the fishing and some mediocre shops, there's not much that the Night Market offers after the first time you get the pearl. But, with this mod installed, you can now get a pearl every year from the Mermaid Show, giving you a valid reward for engaging in the Night Market.

[b]When installing this mod, it will only work from the first Winter 13th that this mod is installed.[/b]

If you enjoy this mod, please endorse it; it means a lot to me and helps other people find it.
